name: Suranjit Sengupta
contribution: Suranjit Sengupta was a lawyer and politician who moved from the left opposition into Bangladesh’s parliamentary politics and Awami League leadership.
context: He served on the 1972 Constitution drafting committee and later became a prominent parliamentary critic during the anti-Ershad struggle.
impact: His career connected constitutional debate, minority representation, and street-level democratic opposition.
